cell.label: Suspected VH: Sudden painless decrease of vision or appearance of floaters, cobwebs, or haze.
Ocular history: trauma, surgeries, underlying retinal diseases including diabetic retinopathy, vascular occlusive disease, history of retinal detachment in fellow eye.
Systemic history: diabetes, hypertension (risk of retinal vein occlusion and retinal macroaneurysm), sickle cell disease, malignancy or bleeding diathesis. Measure blood pressure.
Ocular examination: Red blood cells in vitreous?
Raises suspicion for posterior vitreous detachment or retinal tear.
